column1: # Game profile of Overcooked! All You Can Eat (Switch, update 1.0.11 = v720896)
# Unity 2019.4.11f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD and Pia, SDK 10.4.1. Brought up from the NSP script's provisional profile: the memory values are its measured guesses.
# The shaders are Unity's Shader objects in the Addressables bundles in StreamingAssets/aa/Switch, read by unityfs.py with Unity 2019.4's layouts

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true. The 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region: in its first 15 s the game's
# regions reach alias +3.38 GB (the NSP script's address region check, 2026-10-31); the heap check found no heap set
# The game asks for present interval 2 (30 fps on the Switch) and holds nothing else at 30: one frame per display tick gives 60 fps on the Mac (README.md, Frame rate).
# The registered build selects near-zero NVN depth; offline pipeline bases use main0_z.
